evidence.oralText: 实测汇报一下 Google AI Ultra (20x) 在 Antigravity 上的单周真实额度天花板。这周单号把 gemini-weekly 池子打到了 95.8% 已用（仅剩 4.2%），拉了后端 7 天全量账本……
evidence.conflictsToKeep: 95.8% and 24.95亿 appear only on a self-built telemetry board, not on an official Antigravity Usage popover in this post. Period 11-07 15:50–11-13 16:54 may or may not match the official weekly reset. Cache is 21.70亿 of 24.95亿 (86.1%). API value ≠ subscription quota. Footer comparison with shengtang/KOF97AI 5x 3.05亿 is a cross-account, cross-mix comparison and must not be used to infer a 20x/5x pool ratio. Do not 24.95亿÷95.8%. Image 2 must not be mixed into image 1.
evidence.why: 硬数字来自作者自建 7 日遥测看板，不是官方用量 UI；缓存占大部分；禁止用 24.95 亿÷95.8% 反推周池，也不可与 5x 的 3.05 亿拼接。
